editorial:
You follow four women who team up when ghosts start flooding Manhattan. Erin and Abby are old friends with a shared past, Holtzmann builds wild gear, and Patty brings street smarts. The vibe is loud, silly, and packed with slime, gadgets, and big city chaos. It feels like a fresh spin on a familiar idea, with jokes flying as fast as the ghosts. The movie leans into bright colors, big set pieces, and a playful tone that keeps things light even when the city is in danger.

The cast has strong chemistry, and the action scenes are colorful and energetic. Some jokes land better than others, and the story can feel a bit crowded, but the movie keeps moving. If you want a fun, easy watch, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray. Great for a casual movie night with friends who enjoy silly supernatural comedy.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Rowan turns into a giant ghost and attacks Manhattan. The team uses their proton packs and Ecto-1 to weaken him, then pulls him back through the portal he opened. The portal closes, the city is saved, and the Ghostbusters become heroes. In a post-credits scene, Patty hears a recording say the name Zuul, hinting at another threat.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly supernatural comedies and big action set pieces.
